channel.description: Latest articles from Prince George Citizen (princegeorgecitizen.com)

item.title: NHL trade deadline: A look at some of the names potentially on the move
item.description: NHL general managers have until 3 p.m. ET on Friday to make a splash, tweak the edges of their roster, or secure deals with an eye toward the future.

item.title: LeBron James breaks the NBA career field goals record in the Lakers' 120-113 loss to the Nuggets
item.description: DENVER (AP) — LeBron James broke Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's record for career field goals in the Los Angeles Lakers' 120-113 loss to Denver on Thursday night, with the Nuggets getting 28 points each from All-Stars Jamal Murray and Nikola Jokic.

item.title: Blue Jackets beat Panthers 4-2 in latest blow to 2-time defending champ's playoff hopes
item.description: COLUMBUS, Ohio (AP) — Jet Greaves made 26 saves, Mathieu Olivier scored twice and the Columbus Blue Jackets dealt another blow to Florida's playoff hopes with a 4-2 victory over the Panthers on Thursday night.

item.title: Zion Williamson scores 23 as the Pelicans beat the Kings 133-123
item.description: SACRAMENTO, Calif. (AP) — Zion Williamson had 23 points on 10-for-14 shooting, Trey Murphy III added 21 points and the New Orelans Pelicans beat the NBA-worst Sacramento Kings 133-123 on Thursday night.

item.title: Wembanyama scores 38 as the Spurs sweep the Pistons, 121-106
item.description: SAN ANTONIO (AP) — Victor Wembanyama had 38 points, 16 rebounds and five blocks and the San Antonio Spurs never trailed in completing a sweep of Detroit, beating the Pistons 121-106 on Thursday night.

item.title: Winnipeg Jets send defencemen Schenn and Stanley to Buffalo Sabres
item.description: WINNIPEG — The final horn on Thursday didn’t just cement a 4-1 win against the Tampa Bay Lightning – it closed the Winnipeg Jets’ final on-ice audition.

item.title: Lafreniere sparks a long-awaited home breakthrough as the Rangers rout the Leafs 6-2
item.description: NEW YORK (AP) — Alexis Lafreniere scored the go-ahead goal on a deflection in the third period, and the New York Rangers beat the Toronto Maple Leafs 6-2 on Thursday night to pick up their first regulation win at home in more than three months.
